sql.value: select id, opus_id, file_path, file_path_hash, relative_path, file_name, extension, episode_no, episode_key, display_name, file_size, file_mtime, sort_no, is_primary, last_seen_time, create_time, update_time from ani_media where opus_id = :opusId and is_deleted = 0 and is_primary = 1 order by sort_no is null, sort_no, id

select id, opus_id, file_path, file_path_hash, relative_path, file_name, extension, episode_no, episode_key, display_name, file_size, file_mtime, sort_no, is_primary, last_seen_time, create_time, update_time from ani_media where opus_id = :opusId and file_name = :fileName and is_deleted = 0 order by is_primary desc, id limit 1
